description: Spends prepaid Amazap service credits on a third-party API call, within the account's spend limits. A purchase can't be undone. Only failed calls are re-credited, up to 1,000 sats a day and 500 sats a day per provider. Direct purchases: if you pay a provider's own endpoint or invoice directly, that payment never reaches Amazap. Amazap isn't the seller of that call and can't credit it; the provider's terms apply. Copy quote_id, total_cost, max_total_sats, accept_terms. Params may differ if the price is unchanged. When Lightning payments are temporarily paused, the tool returns payments_paused and retryAfter and charges nothing.

inputSchema.description: Required once: total_cost, max_total_sats, quote_id, and accept_terms. Pass sku for one task, or items for a basket. dry_run true runs the limit, approval, and balance checks and returns that code without spending. simulate_balance_sats and simulate_auto_approve_sats apply only on a dry run.

accept_terms.description: Required. Copy accept_terms from the example buy call. The current terms version, plus the partial-credit token when the listing is marked Partial credit only. A missing value returns terms_required and charges nothing.

confirm_duplicates.description: Set true only to buy the same line more than once. Otherwise a repeated line is refused and nothing is charged.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code used in total_cost. Default USD. Use the user's local currency when you know it. Supported: USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, JPY, CHF, BRL, MXN, INR.

dry_run.description: Set true to run every limit, approval, and balance check and return the resulting code. Nothing is charged, no approval is stored, and the hourly buy slot is not used. simulate_balance_sats and simulate_auto_approve_sats apply only when this is true.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client key. The same key returns the first result and charges nothing.

items.description: Basket. One entry per SKU the user asked for. One total_cost and one approval for the whole list. A repeated line is refused unless confirm_duplicates is true on this call or on that line.

confirm_duplicates.description: Set true to allow this line to repeat.

params.description: Fields from exampleCall or describe_sku for this line. An object, or a JSON array when that SKU body is an array.

quantity.description: How many calls for this line. Default 1, maximum 3.

sku.description: Catalog id or slug for this line.

max_total_sats.description: Maximum all-in sats for this buy, from totalSats. For a basket, the sum. The server rejects the buy and does not pay if the real total is higher. (minimum 1).

params.description: Fields from exampleCall or describe_sku. An object of flat keys, requestBody / query / path, or a JSON array when the SKU body is an array.

quantity.description: How many calls for sku. Default 1, maximum 3.

query.description: Free-text query when the SKU has no listed fields.

quote_id.description: Required. A fresh quote_id from search, describe, or quote that matches this SKU, quantity, and price. A param change is accepted when the price is unchanged and still within max_total_sats. A different price returns quote_mismatch and charges nothing. A missing or stale quote returns quote_required and a fresh quote, and charges nothing. A second buy with the same quote_id returns the first result and charges nothing.

simulate_auto_approve_sats.description: Dry run only. Pretend auto-approve is this many sats. Ignored unless dry_run is true. Use 0 to force approval_required without spending.

simulate_balance_sats.description: Dry run only. Pretend the credit balance is this many sats. Ignored unless dry_run is true. Use 0 to force insufficient_balance without spending.

sku.description: Catalog id or slug for a single buy. Omit when items is set.

total_cost.description: All-in price from search or describe, shown before approval. One price in sats and local currency. Do not put a balance in this string. Example: 53 sats ≈ $0.06. For a basket, one total for every item. (minimum length 1, maximum length 200).

name: buy

outputSchema.description: The same object as the text JSON. code is set when the call stopped before delivery.

approvalUrl.description: Page where the person approves this exact price.

results.description: Search rows when this is a search result.

which.description: per_call, per_day, per_session, per_hour_buys, per_minute_calls, or per_minute_sats.

title: Buy SKU
